issue_request: FHIR-33198 objected that the R4B ballot introduction said resources had their maturity levels increased to level 3+ when NamingSystem only reached FMM 2; it was Published as Not Persuasive with Modification with a resolution to remove the obsolete R4B ballot intro page while acknowledging final R4B metadata was correct.
initial_application: No FHIR-33198-tagged source commit was found. The underlying NamingSystem metadata was applied through FHIR-29945/FHIR-29113: c0e7329f4d updated R4B NamingSystem to FMM 2 and Vocab ownership, and 387eb6b80a applied the same changes for R5.
additional_context: Current source/ballot-intro.html is an active R6 ballot roadmap, not the obsolete R4B page. The historical origin/R4B source branch still contains the stale phrase, but it is outside the current build and the published R4B ballot-intro URL now returns 404. Later FMG minutes on 2023-03-22 approved moving NamingSystem to FMM 4, which commit 1ade81c36b applied in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Source edits were intentionally avoided because removing the current ballot-intro page would damage R6 content and reverting NamingSystem FMM to 2 would conflict with the later FMG-approved FMM 4 update.
